title: Making the Case: How In-House Legal Teams Win with AI
summary: A practical guide for in-house legal teams on how to build the business case for AI adoption, from identifying high-impact use cases and quantifying ROI to managing risk, winning stakeholder buy-in, and turning legal from a cost center into a strategic business partner.
